svg.aria-label: Animated UdyogaSethu app tour: nine screens across workers, farmers and customers
svg.title: UdyogaSethu animated app tour
svg.text: Nine real screens · three roles · one account

g.text: and an SOS button always within reach.
A QR pass that refreshes every few minutes,
so a screenshot can't be reused.
Pins within 25 km, pay shown per day,
Weather advisory and live mandi prices,
so you sell at the right moment.
Set price and stock, pause or edit
Book an electrician, plumber or driver
Fresh produce from farms around you,
